package echo

import (
	"net/http"
	"testing"
)

func TestZZTmpCatchAllClobber(t *testing.T) {
	e := New()
	log := []string{}

	g1 := e.Group("/api")
	g1.Use(zzLogMW("m1", &log))
	g1.GET("/one", func(c Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "one") })
	g1.GET("/*", func(c Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "g1 catchall") })

	g2 := e.Group("/api")
	g2.Use(zzLogMW("m2", &log))
	g2.GET("/two", func(c Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "two") })

	zzCheck(t, e, &log, http.MethodGet, "/api/one", []string{"m1"})
	zzCheck(t, e, &log, http.MethodGet, "/api/two", []string{"m2"})
	// /api/zzz should hit g1's own catch-all route -> m1
	zzCheck(t, e, &log, http.MethodGet, "/api/zzz", []string{"m1"})
}

func TestZZTmpRootRouteClobber(t *testing.T) {
	e := New()
	log := []string{}

	g1 := e.Group("/api")
	g1.Use(zzLogMW("m1", &log))
	g1.GET("", func(c Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "g1 root") })

	g2 := e.Group("/api")
	g2.Use(zzLogMW("m2", &log))
	g2.GET("/two", func(c Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "two") })

	zzCheck(t, e, &log, http.MethodGet, "/api", []string{"m1"})
	zzCheck(t, e, &log, http.MethodGet, "/api/two", []string{"m2"})
}
